// diagnostic

E1274

No package record or build attempt exists for `{pkg}`.

What

No package record or build attempt exists for `{pkg}`.

Why

`jet explain` reads the Hangar Store and persisted Jetpack realization attempts. If neither record exists on this machine, there is no local package explanation.

Fix

Run `jet build <ref>` first; for diagnostic-code help, keep using `jet explain E1234`.
